## Description

What changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build/CI

## Verification

How you tested it: commands run, platforms checked, manual steps.

## Related issues

Closes #

## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test --all` passes.
- [ ] `cargo run --bin docs-gen -- --check` passes if I changed config keys or descriptions.
- [ ] I updated the documentation or regenerated the reference if the change is user-facing.
- [ ] I tested on the platform(s) this change affects (Linux and/or Windows).
- [ ] Breaking changes, if any, are documented in the PR description.

If you changed prose, read the [documentation style guide](https://karloz7715.github.io/Baud/dev/docs-style.html).
